name: official-fraud-rankings
description: Parody leaderboard site — static frontend plus a dependency-free Node backend (SQLite, sessions, membership gates).

scripts.check: node --check server/server.js && node --check server/api.js && node --check server/db.js && node --check server/auth.js && node --check server/dataset.js
scripts.reset-db: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync(require('./server/db.js').DB_PATH.replace(/\\.sqlite$/, ''), { force: true, recursive: true })" && node -e "const p=require('./server/db.js').DB_PATH; for (const s of ['','-wal','-shm']) require('node:fs').rmSync(p+s,{force:true}); console.log('database cleared')"
